# HTML fixtures

Invented pages, each reproducing one ingest hazard from `CLAUDE.md`. They exist so the pipeline can be tested with no network connection, and so every hazard has a test rather than a paragraph.

None of this content is real. It stays invented, so a failing test can never be mistaken for a real answer about a real site.

Nine pages are carried over from the original system. Three were added after this site's survey: a stub that answers success with a refresh instruction, a folder listing whose article is empty, and a page whose markup carries script source inside an attribute. The sitemap carries two entries that are not addresses.
